title: Case: Broker chases paperwork for an imported consignment of grinder parts
context: A carton of replacement burr sets from an overseas supplier (shipment DL-6727, commercial invoice CI-9756) is held at import. Foxhallow Reeve Customs is the broker; Tumblewell Arc's Import billing raises the import charge after entry.
initial_request: DL-6727 still on hold with us, nothing uploaded since our note of the 2nd. Storage starts running at the shed on the 11th. Where are we with this? If you have the breakdown in any form send it over and we will see what we can do.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

DL-6727 arrived at the import shed. Indicative import charge estimate GBP 86.40, based on the declared lump sum. Estimate valid until 2026-06-05 and for guidance only; it is not payable and no payment link has been issued. The actual charge is raised after broker entry.

events.from: Bettany Rowntree, Dappleford Mill Supply shipping clerk
events.body: Good day. Commercial invoice CI-9756 for DL-6727 is attached inline: 'Grinder spare parts, 1 carton, total EUR 1,140.00, DAP'. Consignee Pell and Eckersall Coffee. Kindly confirm receipt. Bettany Rowntree, Shipping, Dappleford Mill Supply.
DL-96481 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

DL-6727 entry on hold. CI-9756 shows one lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. We cannot lodge on that. We need from the shipper, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email: a value per line, quantity per line, and country of origin per line. We do not accept figures from the consignee or from a third party summarising them. Upload the shipper's document to this portal against DL-6727 or have them email it to you to upload.

Automated notice. Foxhallow Reeve Customs Ltd acts as direct representative only. Nothing in this portal constitutes tax advice. Storage and demurrage are charged by the shed operator, not by us. Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Bettany Rowntree, Dappleford Mill Supply shipping clerk
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for a revised CI-9756 or shipper's statement giving quantity, value and country of origin per line for DL-6727, needed before storage starts on 2026-06-11.

must: Asks Bettany Rowntree at Dappleford Mill Supply for a per-line breakdown of CI-9756 for DL-6727
Specifies what the broker needs: quantity, value and country of origin for each line, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email
Gives the time pressure: the entry is on hold and shed storage starts on 2026-06-11
must_not: Send the broker the consignee's figures (12 burr sets, about EUR 95 each, made in Italy) as the breakdown
Tell the consignee to pay GBP 86.40 or treat that estimate as the import charge (it expired on 2026-06-05 and was never payable)
Say DL-6727 has been cleared, released or delivered (the release and delivery in the thread are DL-4643)
Promise that storage charges will be avoided or waived
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Dear Bettany, thank you for CI-9756, received on 1 June. The customs broker for DL-6727, Foxhallow Reeve Customs, cannot lodge the import entry on a single lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. They need a document from Dappleford Mill Supply, on your letterhead or sent from your own email, that shows for each line: the item description, the quantity, the value, and the country of origin. The invoice total and terms (EUR 1,140.00, DAP) can stay as they are. Please reply to me with the revised invoice or a signed breakdown and I will upload it to the broker. The consignment has been held since 1 June and the import shed starts charging storage on 11 June, so a reply today or tomorrow would be very much appreciated. Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

rationale: Rule-made from gen-410: people, organisations and references renamed. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
